chapter: Drumming days and neighborhood life, 1919 onward
title: Lawn parties and Louis Armstrong
summary: Lawn parties on rented yards were common on Sundays. Ernie heard Louis Armstrong play at one, and Dejan describes renting yards and laying tarpaulin for dancing.
